name: FrogTextField
description: A state-hoisted text input with filled, outline, and underline presentations, supporting content, slots, and accessible error handling.

accessibility.talkBackNotes: Persistent or floating label association ensures TalkBack identifies the field after text entry. Error messages are semantically exposed via error semantics. Enabled and read-only states are differentiated.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current text value owned by the caller.

properties.name: onValueChange
properties.description: Callback invoked when proposed text modifications occur.

properties.name: modifier
properties.description: Applied to the outer field container layout.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Primary identifying text label associated with the field.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Secondary contextual hint displayed when value is empty.

properties.name: helperText
properties.description: Non-error supporting information shown below the field when errorText is null.

properties.name: errorText
properties.description: Validation error message shown below the field; activates error styling and semantics.

properties.name: leading
properties.description: Composable slot rendered at the start of the field.

properties.name: trailing
properties.description: Composable slot rendered at the end of the field.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual presentation style: Filled, Outline, or Underline.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Controls interactive capability. When false, user editing is suppressed.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: When true, text cannot be edited but remains focusable and selectable.

properties.name: singleLine
properties.description: When true, the field is constrained to a single horizontally scrolling line.

properties.name: maxLines
properties.description: Maximum visual lines of text allowed.

properties.name: keyboardOptions
properties.description: Software keyboard configuration.

properties.name: keyboardActions
properties.description: Callbacks invoked on IME action triggers.

properties.name: visualTransformation
properties.description: Formats the visual presentation of the text.

properties.name: interactionSource
properties.description: Hoisted MutableInteractionSource to observe focus and interaction events.

properties.name: colors
properties.description: Color specification mapped to current FrogTheme tokens.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: Geometry for the field container border and background.
